name: Howard Lutnick

lean.basis: Major donor to and fundraiser for Trump's 2024 campaign, co-chair of his transition, and commerce secretary since 2025.

sources.title: Bloomberg: Howard Lutnick, Linda McMahon to chair Trump transition team

summary: Howard Lutnick joined the bond brokerage Cantor Fitzgerald in 1983, became its CEO in 1991 and chairman in 1996, and rebuilt it after the September 11 attacks killed 658 of its employees. A major Trump donor, he co-chaired the 2024 transition with Linda McMahon, lost a public contest with Scott Bessent for Treasury despite Elon Musk's backing, and was confirmed as commerce secretary 51–45 in February 2025.
